result.summary: This residential street lacks basic safety infrastructure such as lane markings and marked crossings. The environment is dominated by vehicle storage, with one side of the street consisting entirely of garage entrances and parked cars obstructing the walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked across the walkway on the right side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings and traffic calming measures on a straight residential street may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at intersections to provide designated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center line and parking lane markings to better define the roadway and organize traffic flow.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, continuous concrete sidewalk adjacent to a blank industrial building wall with a roll-up door. While the walkway is unobstructed, the environment lacks pedestrian amenities, lighting, and a buffer from the roadway, creating a sterile and uninviting space.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long windowless wall reduces passive surveillance and creates an uninviting pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical or vertical separation between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians using the walkway after dark.

interventions.title: Facade Improvements
interventions.description: Incorporate murals or architectural details to the blank wall to improve the visual quality of the pedestrian realm.

result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, but they are compromised by debris and significant obstructions from parked industrial equipment. The lack of lane markings and immediate crosswalks, combined with blank building frontages, creates a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large truck and industrial equipment are parked on the right side, potentially blocking the walkway and sightlines.

hazards.name: Debris on Walkway
hazards.description: Loose debris and trash are scattered on the left sidewalk, creating a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the garage door

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at the immediate intersection or midblock area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Regularly clear debris and enforce parking regulations to ensure the full width of the sidewalk remains accessible.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks and row houses built directly to the property line. While the narrow street width likely moderates traffic speed, the lack of a physical buffer between the walkway and the roadway, combined with a large piece of equipment obstructing sightlines, presents safety challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large orange piece of industrial equipment is parked in the street, significantly blocking the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the active travel lane, increasing the risk of conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the street

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and equipment placement near intersections and mid-block points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or planters to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while also improving the streetscape.
